title: Personal Services Plan Account Standing — Months Deducted from a Suspension for Amounts Past Due
content:
When a Personal Services Plan package is suspended for as long as the package allows, an amount past due on the personal services account reduces the months the suspension may run.

## Accounts rule

The amount past due is the balance the plan's ledger shows owed — that is, every package fee, hourly charge, a la carte charge, late or returned payment fee and returned payment, less every payment and credit — less the package fee charged on the ledger on the first day of the current month (nothing where no fee was charged for the current month). It is stated to the cent.

Where the amount past due is at least 100.00 USD, 2 months are deducted from the total months a suspension may run; where it is above zero but below 100.00 USD, 1 month is deducted; where it is zero or less, no month is deducted.

## The ledger reading

| Entries on the plan's ledger | Effect on the amount past due |
|---|---|
| Package fees, hourly charges, a la carte charges, late fees, returned payment fees, returned payments | Added |
| Payments and credits of every kind | Subtracted |
| The package fee posted on the first day of the current month | Subtracted |

## Deduction ladder

| Amount past due | Months deducted |
|---|---|
| 100.00 USD or more | 2 |
| Above 0.00 and below 100.00 USD | 1 |
| 0.00 USD or less | 0 |

Boundary cases (hypothetical): 100.00 USD past due deducts 2 months; 99.99 USD deducts 1; 0.01 USD deducts 1; 0.00 USD or a credit balance deducts none.

## Worked example (hypothetical ledger, request on 12 May)

Charges on the ledger: hypothetical package fees of 300.00 USD for March, April and May, an hourly charge of 120.00 USD and an a la carte charge of 18.00 USD, totalling 1038.00 USD. Payments of 600.00 USD and a credit of 70.00 USD total 670.00 USD. The ledger balance owed is 368.00 USD; less the 300.00 USD package fee posted on 1 May, the amount past due is 68.00 USD, so 1 month is deducted. Had the credit not been on the ledger, the amount past due would be 138.00 USD and 2 months would be deducted.
